name: Roman Sands
source:
The Sun is getting closer. Soon, it will consume everything. It may be one week, it may be two. No matter, just run along and fetch a new round of cocktails. Daiquiris.

A visual novel at the end of the world.

[From [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/monthly/p/october_2019_monthly]Humble Bundle[/url]]
translation:
太阳越来越近了。很快，它就会吞噬一切。可能是一周，也可能是两周。没关系，只要跑过去去拿新一轮的鸡尾酒就可以了。代基里酒。

世界末日的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/monthly/p/october_2019_monthly]Humble Bundle[/url]]
